decks.module: Communicating presence and using the horn

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Let other road users know both your presence and your intended action ____.
cards.back: Let other road users know both your presence and your intended action so they are not surprised.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Headlights help other drivers detect your vehicle in ____.
cards.back: Headlights help other drivers detect your vehicle in rain, snow and fog.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When the windshield wipers are turned on, the headlights ____.
cards.back: When the windshield wipers are turned on, the headlights must also be on.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Switch on headlights as darkness begins so others ____.
cards.back: Switch on headlights as darkness begins so others can see the vehicle.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Use headlights when driving requires lights; parking lamps ____.
cards.back: Use headlights when driving requires lights; parking lamps serve parked vehicles.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When traveling away from a low rising or setting sun, use headlights ____.
cards.back: When traveling away from a low rising or setting sun, use headlights to help opposing drivers see you.
cards.memory_hook: to help opposing drivers see you

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A horn can attract another road user’s attention to ____.
cards.back: A horn can attract another road user’s attention to help prevent a collision.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A light horn tap can alert a driver beginning to move into your ____.
cards.back: A light horn tap can alert a driver beginning to move into your lane or failing to notice you.
cards.memory_hook: lane or failing to notice you

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Use a sharp horn warning when a child or older person is about to enter the street, another vehicle may strike you, or your out-of-control ____.
cards.back: Use a sharp horn warning when a child or older person is about to enter the street, another vehicle may strike you, or your out-of-control vehicle is moving toward a person.
cards.memory_hook: vehicle is moving toward a person

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Do not use the horn to hurry another driver, criticize a ____.
cards.back: Do not use the horn to hurry another driver, criticize a mistake or greet a friend.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Do not sound the horn around ____.
cards.back: Do not sound the horn around a blind pedestrian.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: If a vehicle breaks down on a highway, make it ____.
cards.back: If a vehicle breaks down on a highway, make it visible to other drivers.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When available, use a telephone or two-way radio to notify authorities of a breakdown ____.
cards.back: When available, use a telephone or two-way radio to notify authorities of a breakdown and consult posted emergency contact information.
cards.memory_hook: and consult posted emergency contact information

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: If vehicle trouble forces a stop, get off the roadway away from traffic ____.
cards.back: If vehicle trouble forces a stop, get off the roadway away from traffic if possible and activate hazard flashers.
cards.memory_hook: if possible and activate hazard flashers

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: If you cannot leave the roadway, stop where others can see the vehicle clearly, rather than ____.
cards.back: If you cannot leave the roadway, stop where others can see the vehicle clearly, rather than immediately beyond a hill or curve.
cards.memory_hook: immediately beyond a hill or curve

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Emergency warning devices behind a disabled vehicle give approaching drivers notice ____.
cards.back: Emergency warning devices behind a disabled vehicle give approaching drivers notice and room to change lanes.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Without warning devices, the handbook describes warning traffic from a safe roadside position, ____.
cards.back: Without warning devices, the handbook describes warning traffic from a safe roadside position, using a white cloth if available.
cards.memory_hook: using a white cloth if available

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Never stand in a traffic lane or change a tire if ____.
cards.back: Never stand in a traffic lane or change a tire if that requires occupying the lane.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A raised hood or a white cloth tied to an antenna, mirror or ____.
cards.back: A raised hood or a white cloth tied to an antenna, mirror or door handle can signal an emergency.
cards.memory_hook: door handle can signal an emergency

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Avoid driving beside and slightly behind another vehicle, where its ____.
cards.back: Avoid driving beside and slightly behind another vehicle, where its driver may not see you.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When passing, clear the other driver’s blind spot promptly ____.
cards.back: When passing, clear the other driver’s blind spot promptly rather than lingering there.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Do not remain alongside a bus or truck because large ____.
cards.back: Do not remain alongside a bus or truck because large vehicles have extensive blind areas.

decks.module: Signaling before direction or speed changes

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Warn following drivers before changing direction or slowing so they ____.
cards.back: Warn following drivers before changing direction or slowing so they have time to respond.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Signal before turning, changing lanes, merging or parking, even when no ____.
cards.back: Signal before turning, changing lanes, merging or parking, even when no other road user is visible.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The handbook recommends signaling at least three seconds before a maneuver while separately stating the three ____.
cards.back: The handbook recommends signaling at least three seconds before a maneuver while separately stating the three hundred-foot legal requirement before a turn.
cards.memory_hook: hundred-foot legal requirement before a turn

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Signaling before an intervening entrance or waiting vehicle can mislead another driver ____.
cards.back: Signaling before an intervening entrance or waiting vehicle can mislead another driver about where you intend to turn.
cards.memory_hook: about where you intend to turn

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: After a turn or lane change, check that the signal has canceled and ____.
cards.back: After a turn or lane change, check that the signal has canceled and switch it off manually if necessary.
cards.memory_hook: switch it off manually if necessary

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When slowing somewhere unexpected, the handbook recommends tapping the brake pedal three or ____.
cards.back: When slowing somewhere unexpected, the handbook recommends tapping the brake pedal three or four times to alert following drivers.
cards.memory_hook: four times to alert following drivers

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Warn when slowing to turn from a road without an exit lane, to park near an intersection, or for ____.
cards.back: Warn when slowing to turn from a road without an exit lane, to park near an intersection, or for an obstruction hidden from following traffic.
cards.memory_hook: an obstruction hidden from following traffic

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Give a hand-and-arm signal, an electrical turn signal, or both continuously for at ____.
cards.back: Give a hand-and-arm signal, an electrical turn signal, or both continuously for at least three hundred feet before turning.
cards.memory_hook: least three hundred feet before turning

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: At higher speeds, the handbook recommends signaling over a longer distance, ____.
cards.back: At higher speeds, the handbook recommends signaling over a longer distance, particularly for expressway lane changes.

decks.module: Speed choice, curves and slippery surfaces (A)

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Set speed for road and traffic conditions, available visibility and the applicable limit because higher speeds require ____.
cards.back: Set speed for road and traffic conditions, available visibility and the applicable limit because higher speeds require more room to maneuver or stop.
cards.memory_hook: more room to maneuver or stop

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Slow before a sharp curve, on a slippery surface and where ____.
cards.back: Slow before a sharp curve, on a slippery surface and where water stands on the roadway.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Tire grip depends on the type and condition of both ____.
cards.back: Tire grip depends on the type and condition of both the tire and road surface.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Keep tires in good condition and inflate them according to ____.
cards.back: Keep tires in good condition and inflate them according to the vehicle owner’s manual.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Reduce speed on gravel or dirt because traction is lower than on asphalt or concrete and stopping or ____.
cards.back: Reduce speed on gravel or dirt because traction is lower than on asphalt or concrete and stopping or turning can cause skids more readily.
cards.memory_hook: turning can cause skids more readily

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Slow before entering a curve so braking in the curve ____.
cards.back: Slow before entering a curve so braking in the curve does not create a skid.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Reduce speed at the first rain, sleet or snow because wet or ____.
cards.back: Reduce speed at the first rain, sleet or snow because wet or frozen surfaces reduce tire grip.

decks.module: Speed choice, curves and slippery surfaces (B)

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: For wet roads, the handbook’s speed-adjustment guidance is a reduction of ____.
cards.back: For wet roads, the handbook’s speed-adjustment guidance is a reduction of about ten miles per hour

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: For packed snow, the handbook advises cutting ____.
cards.back: For packed snow, the handbook advises cutting speed in half.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The handbook recommends snow tires or chains on snow-covered roads and ____.
cards.back: The handbook recommends snow tires or chains on snow-covered roads and a crawling speed on ice.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Avoid driving on icy roads when possible, and do not assume studded tires are ____.
cards.back: Avoid driving on icy roads when possible, and do not assume studded tires are permitted everywhere or in every season.
cards.memory_hook: permitted everywhere or in every season

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: On cold wet days, shaded road areas can freeze first ____.
cards.back: On cold wet days, shaded road areas can freeze first and remain icy longer.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Bridges and overpasses can freeze while nearby pavement remains unfrozen because ____.
cards.back: Bridges and overpasses can freeze while nearby pavement remains unfrozen because their surfaces can be colder.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Ice near the freezing point can become wet and more slippery than ____.
cards.back: Ice near the freezing point can become wet and more slippery than ice at much colder temperatures.

decks.module: Wet-road traction and changing traffic speeds

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Hydroplaning occurs when tires begin riding on water instead of maintaining road contact; slowing in rain or on ____.
cards.back: Hydroplaning occurs when tires begin riding on water instead of maintaining road contact; slowing in rain or on a wet road helps prevent it.
cards.memory_hook: a wet road helps prevent it

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Bald or badly worn tires can lose wet-road ____.
cards.back: Bald or badly worn tires can lose wet-road traction at lower speeds.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: If the tires seem to lose road grip, ease ____.
cards.back: If the tires seem to lose road grip, ease pressure off the accelerator.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When grip is lost, keep the wheel straight and avoid stopping or turning until traction returns; if an emergency ____.
cards.back: When grip is lost, keep the wheel straight and avoid stopping or turning until traction returns; if an emergency demands a turn, make it slowly.
cards.memory_hook: demands a turn, make it slowly

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Repeatedly driving faster than traffic and passing creates ____.
cards.back: Repeatedly driving faster than traffic and passing creates additional collision opportunities.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: If traffic collects behind a much slower vehicle, its driver should pull aside ____.
cards.back: If traffic collects behind a much slower vehicle, its driver should pull aside when safe and let others pass.
cards.memory_hook: when safe and let others pass

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Use an entrance ramp to build toward traffic ____.
cards.back: Use an entrance ramp to build toward traffic speed before merging.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Avoid reaching the end of an entrance ramp and stopping; if waiting for a gap, slow ____.
cards.back: Avoid reaching the end of an entrance ramp and stopping; if waiting for a gap, slow earlier so room remains to accelerate.
cards.memory_hook: earlier so room remains to accelerate

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: For an exit ramp, remain with traffic speed on the main road and ____.
cards.back: For an exit ramp, remain with traffic speed on the main road and slow after moving onto the ramp.
cards.memory_hook: slow after moving onto the ramp

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When turning from a high-speed two-lane road with traffic behind, signal and use brake lights ____.
cards.back: When turning from a high-speed two-lane road with traffic behind, signal and use brake lights before reducing speed quickly but safely.
cards.memory_hook: before reducing speed quickly but safely

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Identify slow vehicles early so a lane change or speed ____.
cards.back: Identify slow vehicles early so a lane change or speed reduction can be made gradually.
